plugins.name: git-branch-band
plugins.description: Shows the current git branch or worktree name above the prompt

plugins.name: cache-keeper
plugins.description: Strip above the prompt: a ⋯ picker of sample git items, elapsed time, prompt-cache countdown, context size, 5h and weekly usage, and an always-shown Handoff picker (& Clear, or to a new linked chat on desktop).

plugins.name: notetaker
plugins.description: Live notetaker: keeps a cleaned-up, durable markdown record of the conversation, per chat or one thread across chats, plus a distilled insights file for AIMM teaching, watchable in a side pane (/notes).
